Short answer: Keep important business data in more than one place, with at least one copy separated from the everyday device or account. Then test that you can restore it.

What this means for your business

Start with what would stop sales or operations: customer and booking data, financial exports, contracts, product files, credentials, website source, and configuration. Different tools need different backup methods.

What to watch

  • Everything synced to one cloud account with one login.
  • Exports never taken from a critical SaaS tool.
  • The backup drive always connected to the same computer.
  • Nobody has restored a file or knows the recovery account.

Do this next

  1. List the data that would hurt most to lose.
  2. Find where each original and backup copy lives.
  3. Add a separate protected copy and recovery access.
  4. Restore one file and record the steps and date.
